text.text: Bins, parked motorbikes and other things on the pavement narrow the walking path. They create bottlenecks that force people to step around them.
Parks, beaches, homes and shops are not always joined by a continuous path. Roads, car parks and buildings break the route between them.
Six obstacles to walking in Hulhumalé. Illustrations by the Hulhumalé group.
text.label: Figures

text.text: Large blocks, and separate zones for homes, shops, sport, beaches and community buildings, make walks long. In the heat, with little shade, longer walks are less inviting.
